extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF/figure and supplement sources; no worker-5 expansion beyond preventing overclaim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary source supports pseudocin 196 identity as a class I/type II lantibiotic produced from pscA/pscM/pscT with post-translationally modified mature peptide mass confirmed by MALDI-TOF.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: pseudocin 196 produced by B. pseudocatenulatum MM0196 and heterologous B. breve pBC1.2:pscAMT
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports identity, production, and biosynthetic processing; it does not prove a direct pore-formation or cell-wall-biosynthesis killing mechanism in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly supports antimicrobial activity by well diffusion and MIC assays against Gram-positive indicator/pathogen strains, with heat and pH robustness of the activity; these are activity/stability readouts rather than direct molecular killing-mechanism assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote activity, heat stability, pH stability, or background lantibiotic discussion to a direct mechanism class.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper proposes a biosynthesis/immunity model involving PscM modification, PscT transport, and PscEFGH-related immunity, but explicitly leaves the precise immunity mechanism requiring further exploration.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: psc gene cluster and producer/immunity context
direct_assay_types: constructed-derivative well diffusion phenotype for pscAMT production
producer immunity phenotype in L. cremoris constructs
mechanism_claims.limitations: The producer-immunity mechanism is not resolved; final curation preserves it as a proposed model rather than verified direct antimicrobial killing mechanism.
